scope: Read-only current registry + all 45 native planner simulations, with/without conditional options. No fresh external research. Production files not changed for this census.
interpretationNotes: Every ready template passes native academic credit/count validation; this is stronger than mere title coverage. Zero full validations does not mean zero useful degree plans: personal-admission notes and blanket program.unresolved text are also hard errors.
Compiler sets completeExecutablePathway=false for every generated model by design, citing individual admission/transfer approval. That flag is not an independent completeness test.

Planner coverage.researchGapCredits means University-assigned credit without a mapped outside option and without institutionalOnly. Those rows can be actual named university courses; they are not necessarily missing degree requirements. They cannot prove that maximum transfer has been reached.
No sums of semester credits, quarter credits and WGU competency units are used to quantify cross-school totals.

Outside evidence published means modeled publication provenance, not personal acceptance, provider-version validity or exact placement assurance. Conditional can mean documented personal conditions, provider-reported award, community report, category proposal or unresearched program scope; these meanings currently share one flag.
235 counts literal provider+option.code; 210 merges explicitly supplied aliases only. Neither count establishes current availability or a university-approved course version.

The native simulation used all modeled providers, no existing credits, transfer priority and a 12000-node budget. Costs/terms lack student assumptions; that absence must not be presented as a verified zero cost or duration.

excludedFromNewCourseSourceCount.modern-states: CLEP preparation/voucher enabler, not a distinct transcript issuer
